basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, working as a mechanical engineer. I spend my free time diving into new hobbies like CNC machining and occasionally flying my Holy Stone drone. I'm single and enjoy late-night Reddit sessions, usually between 10 PM and 1 AM. I dislike unorganized information and always look for structured tutorials and guides. My weekends are often spent tinkering with new projects or catching up on the latest anime series.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, which laid the foundation for my interest in CNC machining. I've been self-teaching myself through online resources and forums. My curiosity often leads me to explore various tech-related subreddits, where I've developed a moderate understanding of SVG creation and design software.
